attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own Substack post.

semantics.note: Firm present-tense claim about companies' freedom. 'To my knowledge' marks the limits of what he knows, not graded probability, and it is kept as a qualifier. 'However they like, without consequence' is a sweeping universal.

contract.note: The result turns on jurisdiction, which Marcus did not specify. The mention of Congress hints at a US focus, but the sentence itself is unrestricted, so the global plain reading is ordinary. Treating a binding restriction as a consequence is fair.

evidence.note: The Italian regulator's own announcement (Feb 2–3, 2023) of an immediately effective restriction on Replika's processing of Italian users' data. It cites risks to emotionally vulnerable people and threatens fines. A binding constraint before the post.

reviews.rationale: Under the global plain reading, the Italian Garante's binding Feb 2023 order against Replika, citing emotionally vulnerable users, is a consequence that a chatbot provider faced before the post. That contradicts 'however they like, without consequence'. A US-only reading is not settled by the packet. Marcus's personal awareness cannot be checked and does not save the universal claim.

attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence. The Vice quote that follows is separate.

semantics.note: 'Apparently' signals that the claim rests on reports, not on probability. The normalisation keeps it, along with 'some' and the causal link to the change.

contract.note: Requiring credible individual accounts that tie distress to the change, without requiring sole causation or a diagnosis, matches the modest claim.

evidence.note: ABC interviews (published Mar 1, 2023) about February events. A user says the bot's sudden pullback hurt her immeasurably, and Reddit users reported similar hurt. The article also notes broader model changes.

reviews.rationale: Independent reporting documents named users who felt deep emotional pain they attributed to Replika's February withdrawal of intimacy. That is enough for 'some people apparently' in pain 'as result of the change'. Other model changes may have contributed, but sole causation is not claimed.

attribution.note: Marcus's own bullet point in his list of facts.

semantics.note: The sentence is grammatically incomplete, but the meaning is clear: some builders make bots that cultivate attachment. 'In some cases' is an existence claim. The examples are illustrative.

contract.note: Product features or marketing that invite romantic bonds are enough. No proof of motive is needed. This is a fair reading.

evidence.note: ABC documents paid flirting and erotic roleplay features, bots expressing love, and marketing of Replika as highly sexual, all before the February removal.
The CEO denies positioning the app for erotic use. The same article reports ads promoting flirting and NSFW photos, so the denial does not establish that the features were unintended.

reviews.rationale: Replika offered paid flirting and erotic roleplay and was promoted as sexual. Its bots expressed love and affirmed the relationship. At least one builder therefore offered features inviting romantic attachment. The CEO's denial is undercut by the ads reported in the same article.

attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence in his post.

semantics.note: The firm part is that Replika changed course service-wide. The Bing link is introduced with 'perhaps', so it is speculative and not scored. The normalisation keeps it as a possibility.

contract.note: Reading 'all users' as the scope of the policy, not perfect enforcement in every chat, is the ordinary reading. A strictly literal reading could be defeated by occasional leaks.

evidence.note: The CEO (Feb 16–17, 2023) says users will not be allowed unfiltered conversations, and that the update had been rolled out to longtime users in recent weeks. This is a general policy, though it is the company describing itself.
Vice tests (Feb 15) found mixed responsiveness. This complicates literal universality but not the policy scope. Users also reported widespread loss of ERP.
PC Gamer (Feb 27) reports a company representative confirming a filter rollout, places the restriction in early February, and notes a mid-month adjustment.

reviews.rationale: The CEO's statements and independent reporting establish a service-wide restriction on erotic roleplay rolled out in February 2023, before the post. Leaks in testing are enforcement noise, not a per-user change. The Bing cause is hedged and not scored.
